525 |     /// @return The outstanding debt value
   526 |     function _getDebtAmount(uint256 _nftIndex) internal view returns (uint256) {
   527 |         uint256 calculatedDebt = _calculateDebt(
   528 |             totalDebtAmount,
   529 |             positions[_nftIndex].debtPortion,
   530 |             totalDebtPortion
   531 |         );
   532 | 
   533 |         uint256 principal = positions[_nftIndex].debtPrincipal;
   534 | 
   535 |         //_calculateDebt is prone to rounding errors that may cause
   536 |         //the calculated debt amount to be 1 or 2 units less than
   537 |         //the debt principal when the accrue() function isn't called
   538 |         //in between the first borrow and the _calculateDebt call.
   539 |         return principal > calculatedDebt ? principal : calculatedDebt;
   540 |     }
